messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
May the UR10e arm of the cell be put into service on the sole basis of the declaration supplied by its manufacturer, before the complete robot cell has been declared in conformity?

response.text: Il braccio UR10e della cella può essere messo in servizio unicamente sulla base della dichiarazione fornita dal suo costruttore, prima che l'intera cella robotizzata sia stata dichiarata conforme?
